description:
"Show me the source."
     For a specific document, return the full citation chain in one call:
    metadata (with all dates and identifiers), permanent legal_link, signed
    URL to the original source file (if available), and the full document
    body in markdown or plain text. Designed for auditability.

document_id.description: Numeric document_id from any listing/search tool

include_source_url.description: Fetch a temporary signed URL to the original file (PDF etc.) where available (default True).

iso.description: Document's jurisdiction ISO code, e.g. 'IE', 'NL', 'US', etc.

name: evidence_pull
